name: Quality Feedback Count Adaptation
definition: A dynamic pruning mechanism that adjusts the final Gaussian count based on the training PSNR ($\rho$), using a keep ratio function to compress or expand the population relative to the learning allowance.
summary: Quality Feedback Count Adaptation dynamically adjusts Gaussian pruning based on training PSNR, replacing fixed ratios to retain more primitives for complex scenes and fewer for simple ones.
